info.name: EventMitra - Owner API
info.description: Signup, test OTP verification, login/logout, and password recovery. Signup first creates a pending owner; names must be unique. Test OTP is 1111 and real email/SMS delivery is not connected. OTPs are disabled in production. Reset uses a verified password-reset token, not a general verification token. Run signup once; use existing-account auth folders separately afterward. Bank account add/list/get and default-only update are included; apply migration 014 and fill bank_* environment fields. Migration 015 venue/configuration APIs are included in a separate folder; set venue_name and admin venue_owner_id. Slots, decorations, meals and prices now use a single POST save endpoint with an optional record ID for updates. Null venue child record IDs create new rows; populated IDs update existing rows. Separate child PUT routes are removed. Three venue-scoped price dropdowns provide slot, decoration and meal options. Migration 018: owner signup requires unique user_name; owner_name may repeat. Login uses email or user_name. Verification purpose OTP creates a bearer session; password-reset proof does not. Migration 019 adds venue_address. Shared authenticated multipart upload: POST /api/uploads. Migration 020 adds is_default (false on insert), one fallback per venue/slot, and booking_date price resolution for user venue search/detail, quote and creation. Full endpoint changes: docs/default-venue-pricing.md.

item.description: Apply migration 015. Run separately with existing credentials. Set venue_name; admin also selects venue_owner_id from the dropdown. Creates a venue, two slots, singleton amenities, decoration, two meals and linked prices. Owner edits to approved venues require review. Admin actions use venue_management module grants.
